balls.text: top wide yorker to finish off. Klaasen squeezes it out towards deep extra cover and both batters have ample time to complete a brace
goodness gracious! Slower ball banged into the track outside off. Klaasen stands up tall this time and flat-bats it over long on!
excellent slower yorker outside off. Klaasen bunts it out towards deep extra cover and Nitish scampers back for the second. He was running to the danger end and made it comfortably
lovely! Back of a length outside off. Klaasen reads the bowler's plans like the morning daily and steps across early. Shovels it past square leg and picks up four!

slow and short outside off. Klaasen jumps up into the air to fetch it and misses. Klaasen, though, wants to check for the wide. The ball is not above the head but Klaasen was up on his toes, perhaps even slightly in the air. Below the helmet and within the guidelines, says the third umpire, and the non-wide call stands!
slower ball dug into the track outside off. Nitish has a huge mow at it and drags it towards long on
Boult cannot close out the over! Tries the yorker but Klaasen has telegraphed this. Shapes up for the lap even before Klaasen has released it and scoops it over short fine leg!
speared in full on the pads. Klaasen swings at it and misses. The ball loops up off the front pad and rolls away to the left of the stumps
very full on the stumps again. Klaasen does not middle it but manages to slice it enough to long off's left to pick up a brace
Klaas-y! Right in the slot outside off. Klaasen has all the room he needs and blasts this between deep cover and long off!
low full toss outside off. Nitish clears his front leg and drags it towards deep mid wicket
very full on middle and off. Klaasen hangs deep in his crease and drills it down to long off. Klaasen is unhappy he could not get elevation on that
wide yorker to end the over. Nitish swings at it with all his might and squirts it off the bottom edge towards short third

wow, just wow! Goes for the wide yorker but errs on the fuller side. Nitish throws himself at it, gets under this and his bat speed means that the ball flies over extra cover. Hits the rope on the full, and that is some shot!
shot! Another excellent wide yorker but Nitish is just too good on this occasion. Brings out the reverse lap and beats short third to his left!

full and wide outside off. Nitish swishes and misses. It was beyond the tramlines but the umpire did not call it a wide. Nitish wants to take this upstairs. He might have a case. He did not seem to move very far across. Nitish is stood just outside off and the umpire reckons the ball was within the revised guidelines (because of Nitish's movement). Original call stays!
into the blockhole outside off. Klaasen, despite sitting deep in his crease, cannot get under it and clinks it towards deep mid wicket
gets the wide yorker outside off. Nitish dangles his bat and chalks it off the toe-end just behind point
shortish and well outside off. Klaasen walks across his stumps and cuts it past cover point for a couple of runs
slowed up on a length way outside off. Asks Klaasen to fetch it and he can only get it as far as his front pad
very full on middle and leg. Nitish cannot get under it and clinks it down the ground to long on
length ball well outside off. Klaasen fetches it and flat-bats it down the ground towards long on, who is stationed very straight
Klaasen goes bang-bang! Long-hop outside off and it gets the treatment it deserves. Klaasen uses the depth of the crease and mauls it over long on! A 98m six!

first round to Klaasen, just! Floated up full on middle and off. Klaasen sits deep in his crease, clears his front leg and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket. The fielder, while right on the edge of the rope, tries to push it back in but fails to do so!
carrom ball darted into the pads. Nitish has a massive swing at it and misses it completely. Pings into the pads and then his forearm
carrom ball on a fullish length on leg stump. Nitish looks for the reverse over point but does not quite nail it. Gets hit on the back thigh
short and wide outside off. Nitish thought about swishing at it before bailing out at the very end. Called a wide, rightly
Nitish Kumar Reddy is having a ball in Hyderabad! A bit of a drag-down on middle and leg. Nitish rocks onto the back foot and smears it over wide long on!
Nitish celebrates his fifty with a six! Seems like another carrom ball but this is in the slot on off stump. Nitish brings those long levers into play and wallops it over wide long on!
carrom ball on a shortish length on off. Klaasen turns it towards deep mid wicket
length just outside off. Nitish comes half forward and knocks it to long on. Brings up a 30-ball fifty, and SRH would want him to carry on!
hard length on off. Klaasen hops up onto his toes and stabs it towards short mid wicket
fullish on middle and off. Klaasen is caught on the crease and pokes at it tentatively. Chunks off the inside edge towards square leg

no need for any review this time! Avesh sticks to nailing the wide yorkers and that prompts Head to do something different. Walks across and looks for the lap. Gets a good piece of it but deflects it straight into middle stump. Middle stump is flat on the ground, and Head has to walk back after a 44-ball 58!

smart work by Samson, and has he gotten the better of Head here?! Full and wide outside off. Head, having taken a step across his stumps, swishes at it and misses. Over-balances thereafter and seems to be in a daze at what has happened. Samson senses this and throw down the stumps at the batter's end. Head seems to be late in grounding his bat behind the crease, and the bat seems to be up in the air when the bails are dislodged. But the umpire does not share that opinion. He says the bat is grounded, and Head stays! The RR dugout is not happy with the decision, and understandably so!
nails the wide yorker this time. Just inside the tramlines and Head cannot squeeze it past the keeper
Head joins in on the fun! Marginally short on leg stump. Head hops up onto his toes, gets inside the line, lifts up his front leg Calypso style and helps it over deep backward square leg!
another wide yorker that is a little too wide. More exercise for the umpire
full toss speared beyond the tramlines on the off side. Head does not lay bat on ball, and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
very full outside off. Nitish looks for the reverse lap with third man up but does not get the purchase he is after. Bobbles off the body towards the keeper
length ball bowled a mile outside off. Head walks right across and powers it towards long off. Head did well to stay on his feet there, that was how far he had to reach out
slower bumper outside off that just does not arrive. Nitish jumps up onto his toes and swats it towards deep mid wicket
hang this in the Louvre! Another slot ball outside off and this is a glorious shot. Nitish goes over extra cover this time and absolutely creams it. Into the second deck!
in the slot but well wide outside off. Nitish swings hard at it and shanks it back to the bowler. Nitish tried to hit it straight, might have been better served trying to go over cover
slower short ball outside off that balloons over the batter's head. Nitish leaves it alone and gets the wide call
full just outside off. Head clears his front leg and powers it on the bounce to long on
third time lucky on the reverse for Nitish Kumar Reddy! Fired in full on leg. The line allows Nitish to make contact and he does make very good contact. Slapped over point for four!
why play the reverse when you can do this?! Floated up full and wide outside off. Nitish gets down low, fetches it from outside off and slams it flat over the bowler's head!
slower and wider outside off. Nitish looks for the reverse again and misses for the second ball running

big appeal, and if Nitish has not hit this, it could be very close! RR do not review, though! Very full just outside off. Seems to spin away a little and beats Nitish on the reverse. Gets hit on the back leg and replays indicate the impact might have been just outside off. Good call to not review!
length ball bowled wider outside off. Beyond the tramlines and called a wide

four more! Chahal sticks to that full and wide ploy, but looks like Nitish is enjoying it. Stands still in his crease, lets his hands do the work and carves it over extra cover. Hetmyer was interested for a while, running to his right from deep cover point, but could not get there!
Nitish climbs into Chahal! Given a bit of air outside off. Nitish comes out of his bunker and goes dead-straight, banging it over the bowler's head!
top yorker outside off. Head tries to force it through the off side but only connects with fresh air
slower delivery banged into the track outside off. Well above the batter's head but Nitish decides to swipe at it. Tugs it towards deep mid wicket
speared in full on the pads. Head digs it out towards deep mid wicket and picks up a single to get to his fourth fifty this season!
shot! Slower bumper outside off. Head picks the variation early, gives himself plenty of swinging room and forehands it past mid off! Would not be out of place at Roland Garros!
in the slot outside off. Head plants his front foot and drills it straight to mid off. A couple of yards either side, and that would have raced away!
short and wide outside off. Too wide, in fact, and the umpire decides to indulge in some exercise
back of a length on the stumps. Nitish punches it towards long on and calls two initially. The second run is not on, though, and they decide against it
full toss on off. Nitish is a touch late on it and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
slower bumper outside off. Gets up very high and Nitish cannot control it the way he wants. Chopped back towards the keeper
this is a shot and a half! Another slower ball but this sits up outside off. Nitish picks it early, stands up on his toes and dumps it over the wide long on fence!
excellent yorker outside off. Nitish throws his hands at it but is late on the stroke. Squirms under his flailing blade
hard length just outside off. Head, having backed away, hacks it down the ground to long off
leg-cutter on a back of a length outside off. Nitish pushes it enough to backward point's right and collects a run
carrom ball on a back of a length outside off. Nitish taps it towards point and calls Head through for the single
Nitish takes on the off-spinner! Right in the slot on off stump and no half-measures from Nitish. Plants his front foot, swings through the line and launches it over wide long on!
darted in full on middle and leg. Head nudges it into the off side and picks up a single
slower and fuller outside off. Head reaches out for it and jabs it towards extra cover
oh! Back of a length on middle and off. A bit of hold in the surface and Head nearly pops it straight to extra cover
shortish on off. Nitish gets into the back foot and works it towards deep square leg
four to finish the over! Full on the pads, and Head does not miss out on this either. Transfers his weight forward, snaps his wrists into the stroke and clips it between long on and deep mid wicket!
back to back sixes for Head! Floats this up fuller and Chahal gets met. Head bends his back knee to get under it and hoists it over long on!
Head breaks the shackles! A drag-down outside off that sits up to be hit. Head rocks back and pummels it a long way over deep mid wicket!
fired in quicker on a length on off. Nitish hangs back and stabs it towards long on
length outside off. Head stays back and punches it towards deep cover point
shortish outside off. Head sits back in his crease and scuffs it towards extra cover
low full toss outside off. Head tries to hit it too hard and tugs it towards long on
very full just outside off. Head digs it out towards extra cover. No real timing on that one

another slower bumper on middle and off. This loops over the batter's head and the umpire calls it a wide. Samson is not happy with the call and goes upstairs. The ball is clearly passing above the batter's head, says the third umpire, and the wide call stands!
full outside off. Nitish comes forward and eases it down to long off
back of a length just outside off. Nitish waits in his crease and pushes it towards short extra cover
length outside off. Head reaches out for it and drills it down the ground to long off
slower bumper on middle and leg. Head has to wait an eternity for it and when he does waft at it, he fails to make contact
full on middle and off. Head comes forward and knocks it to long on
gets it through! Short and wide outside off. A proper hit-me ball. Head obliges by rocking back and cracking it past extra cover. The fielder got a hand to it but it still reached the fence!
length just outside off. Spins back into Head just a shade and he shanks it towards Chahal
back of a length just outside off. Punched past extra cover for a single
back of a length outside off. Nitish goes back and pushes it towards extra cover
short outside off. Head stays back and jabs it towards point for a single
off-pace on a back of a length just outside off. Head stands tall and punches it towards cover point, who half-stops it and parries it towards extra cover, thereby allowing a single
safe! Length on middle and leg. Holds in the surface a bit and Nitish is too early into the stroke. Chips it up but luckily for him, it lands in front of long on
full just outside off. Nitish gets a confident stride in and drives it straight back to the bowler
length ball on middle and off. Jags back in and Nitish plays all over it. Gets pinged on the back leg but that was heading well down leg
back of a length on middle and off. Nitish gets behind the line and punches it towards mid on

and Sandeep into the wickets! Length ball that pitches on middle and off, and nips back in a shade. Anmolpreet tries to flick it away but cannot keep it down. A tame chip towards Jaiswal at mid wicket, who dives forward and completes a smart catch!
brilliant! Shortish on leg stump. Head picks the line early and backs away, giving him the room to free his arms. Plays it late too and knifes it to point's right!
short and wide outside off. Anmolpreet gets on top of the bounce and cuts it towards deep point
sharp bumper, just outside off. Anmolpreet sways out of the way and then sees the umpire call it a wide for height
off the mark in style! Back of a length on middle and off. Anmolpreet shuffles across his stumps, stands tall and flicks it regally over mid wicket!
back of a length just outside off. Anmolpreet presses half forward and stabs it towards mid wicket
fullish just outside off. Anmolpreet comes half forward and pushes it towards mid on

Avesh gets Abhishek! Banged into the track on off. Abhishek tries to help it over the deep square leg fence but does not free his arms fully. It is not a full swing of the bat either, and all he does is pick out the sweeper to perfection. Avesh has a smile on his face, and this is just reward for a tidy start by RR!
slowed up again, on a length just outside off. Drifts into Head before spinning away after pitching. He has a nibble at it and is beaten all ends up
fuller, flatter and quicker on the pads. Abhishek pokes it towards square leg
angled into the stumps. Abhishek turns it into the on side, enough to deep mid wicket's left for a brace

was that a drop?! Tossed up beautifully on a length on middle and off. Drops on the batter late and straightens just enough. Seems to go past the outside edge and somehow misses the stumps too, bouncing over them. Plenty of oohs and aahs..

appeal by Ashwin, not given! Quicker through the air, on a length on off. Head advances and then, with bat and pad close together, fences it into the off side. Ashwin is convinced it is pad first and he has talked Samson into a review. Couple of questions to answer here, apart from whether it hit pad first. Was the impact in line, and was Head too far down the track? Okay, it has hit the pad first. Now, onto Ball Tracking. Ball Tracking has the ball clipping the top of leg stump. Umpire's Call and Head stays!
fizzed through on a length on middle and off. Sticks in the surface and Head pops it into the off side
half-tracker on middle and off, but Head does not capitalise. Pulls it straight to the sweeper at deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Abhishek gets up on his toes and dabs it towards short third for a sharpish single
dug into the track on middle and leg. Skids onto Head and he can only hack it towards deep square leg
shortish just outside off. There is a bit of zip behind this and Head is beaten for pace as he wafts at it. That would have likely found the fence had Head connected...
shot! Boult drops it short and that is just what Head is waiting for. Gives himself ample room and slaps it between extra cover and mid off!
back of a length on leg stump. Head uses the angle and flicks it towards mid wicket. Good timing but could not get the placement right
bowled flat on a length on middle and off. Head goes back and knocks it to long off
fired in on a length on middle and leg. Head is caught on the crease and plonks it back towards the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Head waits for the ball to arrive before meeting it right under his eyes
darted in full on the pads. Abhishek pokes it towards mid on and is content with a single (for now)
Abhishek goes big! Ashwin gives this a bit of air and pays the price. Abhishek dances down the track, gets close to it and pumps it a mile over the sightscreen! A 92m six!
length just outside off. Holds in the surface a bit as Abhishek pats it towards point
full on middle and leg. Abhishek pushes it towards mid on and saunters across to the other end
full and shaping away just outside off. Abhishek comes forward and taps it gently towards short extra cover
hard length on middle and off. Head hops around and punches it down the ground for a single
back of a length on off. Head gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length outside off. This swings away too and Head watches this one go through to the keeper

bursts through the hands! Fullish outside off and this seems to shape away late. Head throws his hands at it and flays it towards backward point. Parag gets both hands to it to his left but cannot hold on. An early reprieve for Travis Head!

huge appeal, and the finger goes up! Bhuvneshwar Kumar has won it for SRH, and they have come back from the brink to upset the table toppers! Full toss zinged into middle and leg. Powell has a swing across the line and misses. Gets pinned on the back leg and the slow, dreaded finger of Anil Choudhary goes up. Powell is disconsolate and he has reviewed but it is immaterial. Even if he is deemed not out, they will not get any runs. The Ball Tracking graphic comes up, and it only confirms what we all knew. Powell is out, and that is that. What drama in Hyderabad. The Rajasthan Royals don't know where to look. They do not know what has hit them. SRH don't know how they have done this. This is a comeback and some, and a tale those at the ground will tell the next generation about!

has Powell been run out?! He sprawled across the turf but was that enough?! Spears in a yorker on the pads. Powell whisks it towards deep square leg. He always wants to come back for the second and stretches every sinew of his body to get there. The dive saves him, and Powell is back on strike!
nails the yorker on off. Powell drills it towards long off and both batters want two. The throw goes to the batter's end again and the throw is wild too. Two completed easily
Powell with another corker of a boundary! Low full toss wide outside off. Powell predicts it and moves across. Gets down low and laps it through the vacant fine leg region!

yorker on the stumps. Powell flicks it towards long on and Ashwin comes back for the second. The throw goes to the batter's end and Powell makes it too. Not great fielding and decision-making by Jansen. Surely the throw should have gone to Ashwin's end?
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Ashwin squeezes it out towards long on

Powell with a magnificent shot under pressure! Cummins goes for the wide yorker again but bowls it a smidgen shorter than he would have wanted. That allows Powell to get under it and he carves this over deep cover point!
another slower bumper, just outside off. Powell tries to catch up with it but just cannot come to grips with the change in pace. Three dots in a row. In the penultimate over
nails the wide yorker, and Powell is all at sea. Perhaps he was not expecting it and is too late to bring his bat down. Squirms under the toe-end, and that is another dot
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Powell swings his bat like an axe but does not make any contact. The crowd finds its voice again!
angled in full on middle and off. Ashwin goes deep into his crease and works it towards long on. Gets Powell back on strike

the Sunrisers Hyderabad are alive! And the Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium in Hyderabad is alive too! Half-volley on the pads. Jurel steps across his stumps and tries to shovel it over deep square leg. The bottom hand comes off ever so slightly, though, and he arrows it to Abhishek, who tracks the ball and holds on to the chance!
full on middle and leg. Jurel, after taking a step down the track, flicks it on the bounce to long on. Settles for the single
back of a length outside off. Jurel goes fishing at it and chunks it off the under-edge towards the keeper

Hetmyer falls! Low full toss slanted into leg stump. Hetmyer's eyes light up and he tries to smash the cover off the ball. Cloths it, though, and long on completes the catch well inside the fence. Are SRH still in this, somehow?
into the blockhole on leg stump. Hetmyer cannot do much with it and digs it out towards the bowler
slower ball dug into the track outside off. Hetmyer has a swipe across the line and chops it towards the keeper
That. Is. Massive. Right in the slot and Hetmyer pounces. Skips down the track and he clatters it a long, long way over long on. A 106m six!
back of a length outside off. Powell has a big swish at it and only connects with fresh air
speared in very full on the pads. Powell closes his bat face early and the ball skews off the leading edge towards cover. Powell wanted the single but his partner was not interested
streaky but they all count! Slower ball on a length outside off. There is just too much width on offer, though, and when Powell throws the plumbing at it, the ball flies past Klaasen!
short and wide, and this is pretty ordinary bowling. More exercise for the umpire and SRH can probably feel the game slipping further from their grasp
low full toss on the pads. Powell tucks it away towards deep square leg and has enough time to saunter back for two
almost takes out the umpire! Full on middle and off. Powell absolutely crunches it back, and the umpire does well to get out of the way!
length ball bowled a mile outside off. Another wide. Not great bowling by Jansen
very full on middle and leg. Hetmyer clears his front leg and drills it to long on
speared down leg. Powell does not get bat on it and Klaasen cannot collect cleanly either. Two extras added to RR's total. Not what SRH would have wanted
low full toss on off. Powell comes forward and stabs it into the wide long on region to get off the mark

straight to long on! Cummins takes out Parag, and is there a twist in this tale!? Full just outside off. Parag, sitting back in his crease, looks to go downtown. This one, though, is just full enough to prevent him from getting under it completely. Jansen makes no mistake on the fence, and both of RR's set batters have been dismissed in quick succession!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Hetmyer opens up his stance and flicks it towards long on
Cummins takes all the pace off and bangs it in. Hetmyer looks for the pull but is beaten by the lack of pace
cutter into the track outside off. Parag has an agricultural swipe at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
full toss on the pads. Parag helps it straight to short fine leg. He will feel he missed out there
Hetmyer lands his first blow! Goes for the yorker but errs just a little on the shorter side. Hetmyer can generate the requisite power and bludgeons it past long on!
slower short ball outside off that just does not arrive. Parag plays three strokes in his head before eventually making contact with the fourth attempt. Cuts it to deep point
wayward slower delivery outside off. Parag leaves it alone and that is an easy call for the umpire
into the blockhole outside off. Parag sits back in his crease and digs it out towards extra cover

just enough on it! Another cutter on a back of a length outside off. Parag swings for the hills and does not quite middle it. But he swung so hard at it and the ball, despite coming off the bottom part of the bat, carried over the sweeper at long on!
slower bumper on middle and leg. Parag has to want an eternity for it and splices his pull towards long on, who fumbles and allows the second
change of pace, on a back of a length outside off. Parag lets it go but the ball sneaks just inside the tramlines
length ball angled across the batter outside off. Parag throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep cover point
right out of the screws! Attempted slower bumper but this one just does not get up high. Up to the chest and Parag can whack that over cow corner!
low ful toss on off. Hetmyer comes forward and eases it down to long on

stumps everywhere! Natarajan with the breakthrough! Very similar to what happened with Travis Head. This is a yorker outside off. Jaiswal tries to lap it away and gets into position. Gets bat on it but only manages to smash it into his stumps. Middle and leg stump are left in a mess, and that might be the window of opportunity SRH were after!
back of a length outside off. Parag sits back and punches it to long off
slower ball on a length way outside off. Beyond the tramlines and called a wide
banged into the track on leg stump. Jaiswal, after backing away, gets into an awkward position and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
slow, short and wide outside off. Jaiswal, having advanced, slaps it towards deep cover point
low full toss on the pads. Parag uses the angle and whisks it away towards deep square leg
authoritative with a capital A! Cutter on a back of a length outside off. Sits up nicely for Parag and he bulldozes this to extra cover's right!
another low full toss, this time on leg stump. Jaiswal makes room and punches it to long on
what a shot! Goes for the wide yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss. Jaiswal shuffles across, gets down on one knee and shovels it over deep square leg!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Parag has a mow at it and shanks it towards deep square leg
off-pace and into the track outside off. Parag waits for it and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket
speared into the blockhole on the pads. Jaiswal digs it out into the mid on region
very full on middle and off. Parag laces his cover drive but Cummins gets just enough in the way to keep it to a single
slower bumper outside off. Parag bails out of the pull and looks quizzically at the umpire. Called a wide
dug in shorter, following the batter outside leg. Jaiswal swipes it away towards deep mid wicket
slower ball on a length on off. Parag stands up on his toes and powers it to long off
top yorker on middle and off. Jaiswal stays leg side and digs it out towards extra cover

into the stumps at the other end, and is that it for Jaiswal tonight?! Very full on the stumps. Parag drills it back towards the bowler, who seems to get a hand to it. Question now is whether Jaiswal had gotten his left foot back. Jaiswal did, and that is sharp work by him. Run-out avoided, and RR still in control!
nails the reverse! Fired in full on middle and off. Parag shapes for the reverse now and gets the purchase he is after. Lifts it over backward point and gets to his fifty - off 31 balls!
shortish just outside off. Parag clears his front leg and aims for the moon. Only swats away a few flies in the process
short and wide outside off again. Jaiswal hops back and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal looks for the reverse hit but does not make any contact. Klaasen gets deceived by all of Jaiswal's movements too and RR get two byes
long-hop, well outside off. Jaiswal reaches out for it and muscles it past extra cover. The sweeper had no chance either. A 30-ball fifty for Jaiswal!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Jaiswal flicks it to long on
low full toss on off. Parag knocks it down the ground to long on
length on middle and off. Holds in the surface a little and Parag plonks it back to the bowler
four more! Strays onto the pads and gets punished. All Parag has to do is get inside the line and tickle it fine past the keeper!
short, wide and put away! Enough width on offer and that is all Parag needs. Backs away to create more room and scythes it over backward point!
fullish just outside off. Seems like a change-up and seems to grip a shade. Parag turns it towards mid wicket
slower ball dug into the track outside off. Jaiswal jumps up onto his toes and shanks it back towards the bowler
full outside off. Jaiswal does not come fully forward but holds his shape, driving it neatly past extra cover for a couple of runs
right up in the blockhole on middle and leg. Jaiswal just manages to jam his bat down in time, and the ball bounces up over the stumps
slower ball on a length outside off. Parag has a huge swing at it and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
that has gone a mile back! Half-tracker outside off and Parag climbs into it. Rocks into position and smokes it into the second deck over deep square leg!
low full toss on middle and leg. Parag flicks it straight to mid wicket
slower ball on a length on leg stump. Parag works it off his pads towards deep mid wicket

another slow short ball outside off. Parag, after shaping up for the pull, bails out. More exercise for the umpire. This seemed a much closer call. And SRH have indeed gone upstairs. The ball is passing above the batter's head, and SRH lose a review!
back of a length just outside off. Parag tries to bunt it past the bowler but Nitish sprawls to his right. Collects it clean and then fires a throw at the stumps, which misses its mark
another slower bumper that goes wrong. Loops over Parag's head and called a wide
back of a length on the stumps. Jaiswal eases it down the ground to long on
hard length on middle and off. Jaiswal stands tall and swipes it towards deep mid wicket. Abhishek dives to his right and picks it up one-handed to quell all chances of a third
shorter and wider outside off. Jaiswal cuts it towards deep point, where Shahbaz misfields and ends up conceding the second
Jaiswal greets Nitish with a boundary! Back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal takes a step to the leg side to open up the area behind point and knifes it past short third!
another slower ball, bowled full outside off. Parag drives it enough to deep cover point's left and canters back for two
slower bumper outside off. Parag thinks about the pull before letting it go. Called a wide
hard length on off. Jaiswal cannot come to terms fully with the change of pace and tugs it towards long on
slower short ball outside off. Jaiswal gets on top of the bounce and swats it towards deep mid wicket. Good effort by Shahbaz to keep it to two
cutter on a back of a length on leg stump. Parag nudges it towards deep mid wicket
length on the stumps. Jaiswal presses half forward and flicks it to long on
length on middle and leg. Parag comes forward and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
hard length on off. Parag stands up tall and knocks it to long on
slower bumper outside off that balloons over the batter's head. Easy call for the umpire

dropped again, this is becoming contagious! Full and wide outside off. Parag gets a little under it and smashes it towards extra cover. Abhishek gets both hands to it, high to his left, but cannot hold on
cutter on a back of a length just outside off. Grips in the surface and straightens. Parag advances to try and force it into the off side but plays all over it
back to back boundaries for Riyan Parag! Length on middle and off. Parag clears his front leg and bashes it over the bowler's head!
four more! Slower ball on a full length outside off. Parag goes through the line and while he does not middle it, he gets enough to clear mid off!
back of a length just outside off. Sticks in the surface a tad and Parag punches it on the bounce to mid off
yorker that follows the batter outside leg. Jaiswal can only jam it out towards the bowler
into the second tier! Dug into the track but this is down leg. Jaiswal gets inside the line and helps it well over the fine leg fence!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Jaiswal gets his bat down in time and squeezes it out to mid off
up and over! Length outside off. Jaiswal cashes in on the width and lofts it comfortably over extra cover!
finds the gap! Back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal stays leg side to free his arms and cracks it between extra cover and cover point!
length ball on the pads. Parag uses the angle and tucks it away towards deep square leg
cleverly done! Attempted yorker outside off. Too much width on offer, though, and Jaiswal can steer it past backward point with an open bat face!
shot! Half-tracker outside off and that is fodder for Jaiswal. Goes deep into his crease and belts it to deep square leg's right!
yorker slanted into leg stump. Jaiswal does well to get his front foot out of the way and jams it out to the bowler
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Parag digs it out towards long on
sprays this a mile down leg. Parag cannot get anywhere close to it and Klaasen collects. Another No ball and this is another big No ball!
into the blockhole outside off. Jaiswal opens his bat face and guides it towards short third, who misfields and concedes the single. That is not all because....Jansen has overstepped
safe again! Dug in short outside off. Jaiswal has a swipe at it and splices it. Gets just enough to clear the fielder at mid wicket

dropped, oh dear! Right in the slot outside off. Jaiswal throws his hands at it and hits it like a bullet. Straight to Cummins, though, and the SRH captain shells a fairly regulation chance. How costly will that prove to be?
gorgeous! Off-pace on a length outside off. Parag stays on top of the bounce, gets his hands through the ball and threads it between cover point and extra cover!
speared in full on middle and off. Parag jams his bat down in time and digs it out
stunning! In the slot, swinging into the stumps. Parag plants his front foot, uses the swing and clubs it over wide long on!
shot! More swing away from the batter but this is a half-volley. Parag springs forward and crashes it clean over extra cover!
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal waits for it and dabs it towards short third
length in the channel. Swerves away late and Jaiswal decides against playing at it. Left well alone
sharp bumper just outside off. Zips off the surface and whistles past Parag's flailing blade
length ball pushed across the batter outside off. Parag watches it go through to the keeper
hard length, angling into the pads. Jaiswal tucks it to mid wicket's left and gets across to the other end
first boundary for Jaiswal! Dug into the track outside off. Jaiswal picks up the length quickly, rocks back and hammers it over mid wicket!
slanted in on a length on off. Jaiswal comes forward and pushes it towards extra cover
oh! Full outside off. Jaiswal goes for the booming off-drive but plonks it on the bounce to mid off
full and swinging into off again. Parag presses forward and punches it towards mid on

cleans him up with an absolute jaffa! Bhunveshwar Kumar at his absolute best! Fullish ball that starts just outside off and boomerangs back in. Samson does not get to the pitch and goes searching for it. Does so in front of his pad and leaves a massive gap. The ball zips through and flattens middle stump!
fuller outside off. Shapes away nicely and Samson lets it go
hard length, angling back into middle and off. Samson hops up onto his toes and stabs it towards mid wicket

the slip is in play straightaway! Bhuvneshwar rips out Buttler again! Back of a length just outside off. A hint of movement away from the batter. Buttler wafts at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies towards Jansen. He gobbles up the chance, and that is just the start SRH would have wanted!
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and cuts it towards deep backward point
